title: Introduce RAG Sandbox Kitchen and Contract MockRunner
author: Asha Menon
description: Introduce a compact local-first RAG sandbox called 'Sandbox Kitchen' plus a lightweight Contract MockRunner for rehearsing tool-call contracts and step assertions. Motivation: authors and SREs need a deterministic, reproducible environment to iterate on retrieval-agent workflows and tool contracts without spinning full CI or cloud infra. This PR delivers: 1) a self-contained sandbox kitchen (node script + minimal docker devcontainer) that runs indexed scenarios, steps through tool calls, and replays synthetic user journeys; 2) a MockRunner that simulates external tool endpoints from contract schemas and records call traces; 3) telemetry fixtures (span and metric emitters) and example probes that hook into the Redwood Console dev telemetry (local mode) so authors can see token/latency/cost signals during authoring; 4) guided step-assertions and a tiny assertion runtime that fails fast on contract mismatches. The description below is a continuous narrative and includes quickstart steps, config flags, and rollout notes. Quickstart: 1) git checkout feature/rag-sandbox-kitchen-mockrunner && npm install 2) npm run kitchen:dev -- --scenario=search-assistant --index=sample-corpus 3) npm run mockrunner:start (spins a stubbed /tool endpoints server) 4) open http://localhost:8080/play in the browser to step through the scenario and inspect recorded traces. Configuration: sandbox supports toggles for deterministic RNG (--seed), replay mode (--replay-only), and stub fidelity (--fidelity={low|medium|high}). MockRunner loads tool contracts from ./contracts/*.json (OpenAPI-lite + tool-schema extensions) and validates calls against the declared contract; mismatches emit an assertion error and an event to the local telemetry sink. Telemetry: the fixtures emit lightweight OTLP-compatible spans and a couple of application metrics (rag.kitchen.steps, rag.mockrunner.failures, rag.step.latency_ms). A local console adapter ships with the sandbox to display traces in a compact timeline; production teams can plug the same fixtures into Redwood Console by swapping the endpoint. Testing and evals: includes 6 scenario fixtures and a small smoke suite that runs in CI (node:14). The PR also adds step assertion examples that demonstrate common contract regressions (missing param, type mismatch, extra side-effect). Docs: adds a new quickstart page under /quickstarts/sandbox-kitchen with step-by-step screenshots and recommended prompt sets for regression detection. Rollout: feature gated under QUICKSTARTS_SANDBOX_KITCHEN and behind a docs-only feature flag in the site config. Backwards compatibility: none of the runtime or production SDKs were changed; this is strictly examples and tooling. Migration notes: N/A. Checklists: - [x] implement kitchen runner and mockrunner - [x] add telemetry fixtures and timeline UI - [x] add scenario fixtures and smoke tests - [x] docs quickstart and code comments - [x] CI workflow integration - [x] reviewer feedback addressed

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Nice ergonomics here — can we reduce the sandbox startup time by lazy-loading the corpus? Author: agree, implemented lazy load in mockrunner v2, removed a blocking parse and startup improved ~350ms.
Lin Zhao: Telemetry fixtures are helpful but the timeline UI needs accessibility labels. Author: added aria labels and keyboard nav for timeline entries.
Priya Kulkarni: The contract validator should report line/field paths for easier debugging. Author: extended error payloads to include json-pointer paths and added examples in the README.
release_notes: Added a local-first RAG Sandbox Kitchen for iterative authoring and a Contract MockRunner for validating tool-call contracts. Includes telemetry fixtures and a quickstart doc. Intended for developer onboarding and regression hunting; no production runtime changes.
